timeline.body:
Fixes #14169 

RELNOTES: `genquery` now supports (unconfigured) cycles, but may have higher peak memory usage. The default value of `--skyframe_high_water_mark_minor_gc_drops_per_invocation` and `--skyframe_high_water_mark_full_gc_drops_per_invocation` has been decreased to 10, which can result in Bazel OOMing more eagerly as Skyframe state is no longer dropped an unlimited number of times in response to high memory pressure.
Nit: flag doc should be updated as well

RELNOTES: `genquery` now supports (unconfigured) cycles, but may have higher peak memory usage. Skyframe state is dropped more eagerly on GCs.
